sentences.text: Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) confirmed attendance for a review with Jamie Rowe (S2) on the day of the conversation.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that his mother (mum) gave him a poster from Leeds for his birthday.
Jamie Rowe (S2) confirmed he is attending college and works in catering on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, where he made pizzas last week.
Jamie Rowe (S2) confirmed he volunteers at the garden centre on Fridays, performing watering and trolley duties.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he sometimes cooks at the flat, but staff help him with the oven; he can make pasta on his own.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig works the night shifts, mostly.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig sometimes gets cross when he gets up for a drink at night.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that when Craig gets cross, he tells him to go back to bed.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that sometimes Craig pushed him into the wall in the hall outside the kitchen.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that he was hurt when Craig pushed him, specifically his shoulder hitting the wall.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated the incident where Craig pushed him into the wall happened last week, specifically on a Thursday night.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig kicked his leg three times.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig kicked the back of his leg with his foot, which caused a bruise and hurt a bit.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig told him not to tell anyone, warning that he would lose his flat if he did.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Marcus told him Craig hit Sophie, but Jamie did not see it himself as he was in his room.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated Sandra helps him manage his money, receiving it on Mondays and using a list.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he sees his mum on Sundays, where she picks him up and they go to Nan's for dinner.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he gets on well with Sandra and Priya.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would report the disclosures of harm by Craig to the safeguarding team at the council.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would ring Sandra to ask that Craig does not work the night shift while the situation is looked into.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would ring Jamie's mum this afternoon.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would bring easy-read information about safeguarding to Jamie.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would return on Tuesday the 1st of December at 4 o'clock after college to see how Jamie is doing.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he wants to go to Blackpool for a holiday.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would discuss the holiday money with Jamie on Tuesday the 1st of December.
